t: How I Stopped Quitting and Started Mking Game
e: Things I Did Before Creating My Game You may to...
s:
how i stopped quitting and started mking game things i did before creating my game you may to... game development godot programming problems & solutions  
all my life, i haven't finished a single game. i always start, make a mess, and then quit. so this time, i have done something different i planned for a few days, not for eternity (some people plan for eternity). here is what i decided:

i will start with my software architecture, and my choices are dependency injection, a context-based hierarchy system, and 'signals up, call down.' these are the core things in my software architecture.

in code, i decided that every piece of code has to be inside a function. if i am doing something big, i will divide it into smaller functions because i think commenting is bad, code shouldn't need comments. only after creating clean code do i use comments.

and i decided that i will add multiplayer and translation before i create the game, which will save a lot of time in the long run.

that's most of it about what i did before creating the game. also, i created this website to keep a record of my journey.

e: The story of me finding my love

in the beginning, god said, 'let there be unity,' and that is how the unity engine was born.

as you know, adobe and unity have a 98% dna match, so for everything i had to go to dr. google. google told me to go to brackeys, and that is how i found my messiah. he saved me from every problem. then came the shocking part.

![my messiah's holy face.](/images/blog/godot-setup/my_messiah.jpg "**my messiah's holy face. isn't that holy?**"){px}

my messiah was gone from youtube for four years. but one day, suddenly, my messiah returned and said,
>the old testament is abolished (old testament = unity). here is the new testament.
i was shocked why, why did you leave the old testament behind? my brain couldn't comprehend the reasoning, but i had faith in my messiah, so i followed in his footsteps.

he showed me the light. i was in darkness, but to me, that was my world; i never thought there was a world this beautiful, beyond imagination.

and that is how i found godot.
